surprises: NT staircase-specialist coverage is genuinely thin. Only two clear staircase specialists (Aussie Stairs Darwin + AXSA Group's Territory Handrails). Most NT capability sits inside multi-service joinery/fabrication businesses (NT Handrails, Top End Joinery, Darwin Joinery).
Southern Timber Works and Blackforest Joinery share the same phone (0400 273 273) and operator (Holger). Same trading entity, two brands - kept as sibling records for downstream merge decision.

Queanbeyan (technically NSW) is the industrial hub for Canberra stair supply - Advantage Industries, Apexa, and Southern Timber Works are all Queanbeyan-based businesses whose primary market is Canberra/ACT. Cross-border NSW→ACT servicers are the norm, not the exception.

Cyclone-rating is a distinct NT capability signal (NT Handrails: 'Category 5 cyclone conditions') - worth adding as a capability flag or evidence_note category if the schema extends to environment-specific specifications.
Stone staircase treads (Top End Joinery) - stone-tread capability is unusual for the UK/IE/US dataset; NT/tropical market appears to use stone for durability + heat performance.

No coverage found for Palmerston NT (search collapsed to NZ's Palmerston North), Katherine, Alice Springs, Nhulunbuy, or Tennant Creek as own-website businesses. Territory Handrails claims to service Katherine/Alice Springs/remote NT from Darwin - realistic given NT density.
